name: Nimesulide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Nigeria and 2 other countries, first in 2005 — for liver harm

summary: Nimesulide was removed from the market in Nigeria and two other countries starting in 2005 due to damage to the liver [3]. In tests run by a small computer model rather than studies on humans, the drug received a high score of 82 for potential liver risk [M]. This same computer model also gave the drug a medium score of 51 for heart-related risk [M].
